``` {r MakeYearlyDF}

# NOT PULLING OUT REFERERNCE POINTS. WHYYYYY
# FBAR IS AGE SPECIFIC, I'M ONLY USING OLDEST
# DO WE DO TRANSFORMATIONS ON LOG STUFF. NOTED BELOW
# WHY IS log_NAA_sigma) VARIATION OF RECRUITMENT
# WHAT IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN mod1$par.est[[1]]$mean_rec_pars and parList$mean_rec_pars[,1] 
# ARE ALL PROCESS PARS IN LOG SPACE? INCLUDING MEAN ECOV ESTS? BECAUSE OTHERWISE THOSE ARE HUGE
# IS EM LIST 16 ELEMETNS BECAUSE THERE WERE 16 ASSESSMENTS? IS THAT CORRECT?


# PROJECTIONS
Proj_ests <- data.frame(Year = c(),
                      EM_name = c(),
                      seed_no = c(),
                      Temp_OM = c(),
                      Temp_OM_Obs = c(),
                      Temp_EM = c(),
                      Temp_EM_Obs = c(),
                      SSB_OM = c(), # SSB_real
                      SSB_EM = c(),
                      FBar = c(), #f bar OM
                      Pred_catch = c(), #Predited catch om
                      Catch_advice = c(),  # catch Advice from EM
                      #THESE STILL AREN'T RUNNING. WHY
                      # log_FMSY_stat = c(), #IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM
                      # log_SSB_FXSPR_stat = c(), #IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM
                      # log_FBar_SXPR_stat = c() #IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM
                      recPars_a = c(), #IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM ? # EM Stock Recruit Relationship 1 # Intercept
                      recPars_b = c(), #IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM ? # EM Stock Recruit Relationship 1
                      Ecov_beta_R_OM= c(), #logitrho for ecov param
                      Ecov_beta_R_EM = c(),
                      OM_RecPar_A = c(),#IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM # Real stock recruit relationship
                      OM_RecPar_B = c(),#IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM # Real stock recruit relationship
                      EM_q = c(),
                      OM_q = c(),
                      OM_NAA_oldest = c(),
                      OM_NAA_youngest = c(),
                      EM_NAA_oldest = c(),
                      EM_NAA_youngest = c(),
                      
                      OM_NAAsigma_oldest = c(),
                      OM_NAAsigma_youngest = c(),
                      EM_NAAsigma_oldest = c(),
                      EM_NAAsigma_youngest = c(),
                      OM_NAA_devs = c(),
                      EM_NAA_devs = c()
                      )

mods <- Mods_proj

# Delete non converged seeds
for(i in 1:length(mods)){ # i = seed, j = model
  
  for(j in 1:length(mods[[i]])){
    if(is.null(mods[[i]][[j]])){
      mods[[i]] <- NA
    }
  }
    

  for(k in 1:length(ModNames_proj)){
      
    years <- min(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["em_full"]][[1]][["years"]]):(max(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["em_full"]][[1]][["years"]]) + 3) #Year
    em_name <- rep(ModNames_proj[k], length(years)) # Model Name
    Seed <- rep(i, length(years))
      # Ecov_x estimates
    om_ecovx <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][["rep"]][["Ecov_x"]][1:98,1] #OM_ecov Temps
    om_ecovObs <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][["input"]][["data"]][["Ecov_obs"]][1:98,1] # om obs temps
    em_ecovx <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["em_full"]][[1]][["rep"]][["Ecov_x"]][1:98,1] #EM_ecov Temps
    em_ecovObs <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["em_input"]][[1]][["data"]][["Ecov_obs"]][1:98,1] # em obs temps REPORTED PER ASSESSMENT. This one I'm not going to care about very much
    # Ecov_Obs estimates
    
    SSB_om <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][["rep"]][["SSB"]][1:98,]  #SSB
    SSB_em <- c(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["em_full"]][[1]][["rep"]][["SSB"]], rep(NA, 3))
    FBar_om <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][["rep"]][["Fbar"]][,1][1:98] #Fbar
    pred_catch_om <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][["rep"]][["pred_catch"]][1:98,] #pred catch
    cat_advice_em <-  c(rep(NA, 51),unlist(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["catch_advice"]]))
    cat_advice_em <-  cat_advice_em[1:98]
    
    Ecov_beta_R_OM <- rep(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][["par"]][["Ecov_beta_R"]], length(years))
    
    om_recpar_a <- rep(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][['parList']][['mean_rec_pars']][,1], length(years))
    om_recpar_b <- rep(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][['parList']][['mean_rec_pars']][,2], length(years))
    
    em_q <- rep(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["em_full"]][[1]][["parList"]][["logit_q"]][1], length(years))
    om_q <- rep(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][['parList']][['logit_q']][1], length(years))
    
    om_naa_oldest <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][["rep"]][["NAA"]][,,,6][1:98]
    om_naasigma_oldest <- rep(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][["parList"]][["log_NAA_sigma"]][,,6], length(years))
    
    om_naa_youngest <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][["rep"]][["NAA"]][,,,1][1:98]
    om_naasigma_youngest <- rep(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][["parList"]][["log_NAA_sigma"]][,,1], length(years))
    
    em_naa_oldest <- c(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["em_list"]][[16]][["NAA"]][,,,6], rep(NA, 3))
    em_naa_youngest <- c(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["em_list"]][[16]][["NAA"]][,,,1], rep(NA, 3))
    
    om_naa_devs <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][["rep"]][["NAA_devs"]][1,1,,1][1:98]
    em_naa_devs <- c(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["em_list"]][[16]][["NAA_devs"]][1,1,,1], rep(NA,3))
    # em_naasigma_oldest <- rep(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["em_full"]][[1]][["parList"]][["log_NAA_sigma"]][[1,1,6]],length(years))
    # em_naasigma_youngest<- rep(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["em_full"]][[1]][["parList"]][["log_NAA_sigma"]][[1,1,1]],length(years))
    
    
    # RECORDING INFO THAT IS REPORTED PER ASSESSMENT YEAR
        df_perAssessment <- data.frame(years_trace = years,
                                   recPars_a = NA,
                                   recPars_b = NA,
                                   Ecov_beta_R_EM = NA,
                                   em_naasigma_oldest = NA, 
                                   em_naasigma_youngest = NA)
    for(q in 1:length(years)){
      if(years[q] %in% assess.years){

        assess.no <- which(assess.years == years[q])

        df_perAssessment$recPars_a[q:(q+2)] <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][['par.est']][[assess.no]]$mean_rec_pars[,1] # REPORTED PER ASSESSMENT
        df_perAssessment$recPars_b[q:(q+2)] <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][['par.est']][[assess.no]]$mean_rec_pars[,2] # REPORTED PER ASSESSMENT

        df_perAssessment$Ecov_beta_R_EM[q:(q+2)] <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][['par.est']][[assess.no]][["Ecov_beta_R"]]
        
        df_perAssessment$em_naasigma_oldest[q:(q+2)] <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][['par.est']][[assess.no]][["log_NAA_sigma"]][,,6]
        df_perAssessment$em_naasigma_youngest[q:(q+2)] <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][['par.est']][[assess.no]][["log_NAA_sigma"]][,,1]


      }}
    
    data_List <- data.frame(Year = years,
                      EM_name = em_name,
                      seed_no = Seed,
                      Temp_OM = om_ecovx,
                      Temp_OM_Obs = om_ecovObs,
                      Temp_EM = em_ecovx,
                      Temp_EM_Obs = em_ecovObs,
                      SSB = SSB_om,
                      SSB_EM = SSB_em,
                      FBar = FBar_om, #AGE SPECIFIC. ONLY DOING OLDEST AGE GROUP OFR F BAR
                      Pred_catch = pred_catch_om,
                      Catch_advice = cat_advice_em,
                      # log_FMSY_stat = FMSY,
                      # log_SSB_FXSPR_stat = SSB_FXSPR,
                      # log_FBar_SXPR_stat = FBar_SXPR
                      EM_recPars_a = df_perAssessment$recPars_a, #IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM? # est stock recruit relationship
                      EM_recPars_b = df_perAssessment$recPars_a, #IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM? # est stock recruit relationship
                      Ecov_beta_R_OM = Ecov_beta_R_OM,#IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM?
                      Ecov_beta_R_EM = df_perAssessment$Ecov_beta_R_EM,
                      OM_RecPar_A = om_recpar_a,#IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM # Real stock recruit relationship
                      OM_RecPar_B = om_recpar_b,
                      EM_q = em_q,
                      OM_q = om_q,
                      OM_NAA_oldest = om_naa_oldest,
                      OM_NAA_youngest = om_naa_youngest,
                      EM_NAA_oldest = em_naa_oldest,
                      EM_NAA_youngest = em_naa_youngest,
                      
                      OM_NAAsigma_oldest = om_naasigma_oldest,
                      OM_NAAsigma_youngest = om_naasigma_youngest,
                      EM_NAAsigma_oldest = df_perAssessment$em_naasigma_oldest,
                      EM_NAAsigma_youngest = df_perAssessment$em_naasigma_youngest,
                      OM_NAA_devs = om_naa_devs,
                      EM_NAA_devs = em_naa_devs
                      )
    
    Proj_ests <- rbind(Proj_ests, data_List)
    
      
  }
  }

```{r bbmsy}

mods <- Mods_proj
# r is seed, m is em NO

BRP_data <- data.frame(Year = c(), # which EM comes up wiht most accurate BRP, too optimistic/too pessimistic eventual over or under exploitation. % model runs em exceeds catch goal
                      EM_name = c(),
                      Seed_no = c(),
                      
                      OM_Fbar = c(),
                      OM_SSB = c(),
                      OM_log_FMSY_static = c(),
                      OM_log_FMSY = c(),
                      OM_log_SSB_FXSPR_static = c(),
                      OM_log_SSB_FXSPR = c(),
                      OM_log_Fbar_XSPR = c(),
                      OM_log_Fbar_XSPR_static = c(),
                      OM_log_FXSPR_static = c(),
                      
                      EM_Fbar = c(),
                      EM_SSB = c(),
                      EM_log_FMSY_static = c(),
                      EM_log_FMSY = c(),
                      EM_log_SSB_FXSPR_static = c(),
                      EM_log_SSB_FXSPR = c(),
                      EM_log_Fbar_XSPR = c(),
                      EM_log_Fbar_XSPR_static = c(),
                      EM_log_FXSPR_static = c()
                      )



for(r in 1:length(mods)){ # r is seed No, m is model
  for(m in 1:length(mods[[r]]))
  {
    if(is.null(mods[[r]][[m]])){
      mods[[r]] <- NA
    }
    
    model <- mods[[r]][[m]]
                      input <- model$om$input
                      input$random <- NULL
## UNCOMMENT ONCE TESTING IS OVER                      
                      if (!is.null(input$data$FXSPR_init)) {
                        input$data$FXSPR_init[] <- 2
                      }
                      if (!is.null(input$data$FXSPR_static_init)) {
                        input$data$FXSPR_static_init[] <- 2
                      }

                      om_brp <- try(
                        fit_wham(input,
                                 n.newton         = 10,
                                 do.fit           = FALSE,
                                 do.brps          = TRUE,
                                 MakeADFun.silent = TRUE),
                        silent = TRUE
                      )
      em_size <- length(model[["em_list"]])
                      
      year <- om_brp[["years"]]
      eM_name <- rep(ModNames_proj[m], length(om_brp[["years"]]))
      seed_no <- rep(r, length(om_brp[["years"]]))
      
      
      # OM Info                
      oM_Fbar <- om_brp[["rep"]][["Fbar"]][,1]
      oM_SSB <- om_brp[["rep"]][["SSB"]]
                      
      oM_log_FMSY_static <- rep(om_brp[["rep"]][["log_FMSY_static"]], length(om_brp[["years"]]))
      oM_log_FMSY <- om_brp[["rep"]][["log_FMSY"]]
      
      oM_log_SSB_FXSPR_static <- rep(om_brp[["rep"]][["log_SSB_FXSPR_static"]][1], length(om_brp[["years"]]))
      oM_log_SSB_FXSPR <-  om_brp[["rep"]][["log_SSB_FXSPR"]][,1]
      
      oM_log_Fbar_XSPR <- om_brp[["rep"]][["log_Fbar_XSPR"]][,1]
      oM_log_Fbar_XSPR_static <- rep(om_brp[["rep"]][["log_Fbar_XSPR_static"]][1], length(om_brp[["years"]]))
      oM_log_FXSPR_static <- rep(om_brp[["rep"]][["log_FXSPR_static"]], length(om_brp[["years"]]))
      
      #EM COMPARISONS                
      eM_Fbar <- c(model[["em_list"]][[em_size]][["Fbar"]][,1], rep(NA, 5))
      eM_SSB <- c(model[["em_list"]][[em_size]][["SSB"]], rep(NA, 5))
                  
      eM_log_FMSY <- c(model[["em_list"]][[em_size]][["log_FMSY"]], rep(NA, 5))
      # EM_log_FMSY_static <- rep(model[["em_list"]][[16]][["log_FMSY_static"]], length(om_brp[["years"]])) ### 1
      
      # EM_log_SSB_FXSPR_static <- rep(model[["em_list"]][[16]][["log_SPR_FXSPR_static"]][1], length(om_brp[["years"]]))###1
      eM_log_SSB_FXSPR <- c(model[["em_list"]][[em_size]][["log_SSB_FXSPR"]][,1], rep(NA, 5))
                      
      eM_log_Fbar_XSPR <- c(model[["em_list"]][[em_size]][["log_Fbar_XSPR"]][,1], rep(NA, 5))
      # EM_log_Fbar_XSPR_static <- rep(model[["em_list"]][[16]][["log_Fbar_XSPR_static"]], length(om_brp[["years"]])) ###3
                  
      # EM_log_FXSPR_static <- rep(model$em_list[[16]]$log_FXSPR_static, length(om_brp[["years"]])) ###1
      eM_log_FMSY_static <- rep(NA, 50)
      eM_log_SSB_FXSPR_static <- rep(NA, 50)
      eM_log_FXSPR_static <- rep(NA, 50)
        
      eM_log_Fbar_XSPR_static <- rep(NA, 50)
      
      
      for(j in 1:length(model[["em_list"]])){
        
        eM_log_FMSY_static <- append(eM_log_FMSY_static, rep(model[["em_list"]][[j]][["log_FMSY_static"]], MSE_Length)) ### 1
        eM_log_SSB_FXSPR_static <- append(eM_log_SSB_FXSPR_static, rep(model[["em_list"]][[j]][["log_SSB_FXSPR_static"]][1], MSE_Length)) ### 1
        eM_log_FXSPR_static <- append(eM_log_FXSPR_static, rep(model[["em_list"]][[j]][["log_SPR_FXSPR_static"]][1], MSE_Length)) ### 1
        eM_log_Fbar_XSPR_static <- append(eM_log_Fbar_XSPR_static, rep(model[["em_list"]][[j]][["log_Fbar_XSPR_static"]][1], MSE_Length))
          #rep(model[["em_list"]][[16]][["log_Fbar_XSPR_static"]], length(om_brp[["years"]])) ###3
      }
      
      eM_log_FMSY_static <- append(eM_log_FMSY_static, rep(NA, 2)) ### 1
      eM_log_SSB_FXSPR_static <- append(eM_log_SSB_FXSPR_static, rep(NA, 2)) ### 1
      eM_log_FXSPR_static <- append(eM_log_FXSPR_static, rep(NA, 2)) ### 1
      eM_log_Fbar_XSPR_static <- append(eM_log_Fbar_XSPR_static, rep(NA, 2))
      
      data_List <- data.frame(Year = year,
                      EM_name = eM_name,
                      Seed_no = seed_no,
                      
                      OM_Fbar = oM_Fbar,
                      OM_SSB = oM_SSB,
                      OM_log_FMSY_static = oM_log_FMSY_static,
                      OM_log_FMSY = oM_log_FMSY,
                      OM_log_SSB_FXSPR_static = oM_log_SSB_FXSPR_static,
                      OM_log_SSB_FXSPR = oM_log_SSB_FXSPR,
                      OM_log_Fbar_XSPR = oM_log_Fbar_XSPR,
                      OM_log_Fbar_XSPR_static = oM_log_Fbar_XSPR_static,
                      OM_log_FXSPR_static = oM_log_FXSPR_static,
                      
                      EM_Fbar = eM_Fbar,
                      EM_SSB = eM_SSB,
                      EM_log_FMSY_static = eM_log_FMSY_static,
                      EM_log_FMSY = eM_log_FMSY,
                      EM_log_SSB_FXSPR_static = eM_log_SSB_FXSPR_static,
                      EM_log_SSB_FXSPR = eM_log_SSB_FXSPR,
                      EM_log_Fbar_XSPR = eM_log_Fbar_XSPR,
                      EM_log_Fbar_XSPR_static = eM_log_Fbar_XSPR_static,
                      EM_log_FXSPR_static = eM_log_FXSPR_static
                      )
    
    BRP_data <- rbind(BRP_data, data_List)
    
                      
  }}

BRP_data <- BRP_data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(MSYOverfishing_OM = OM_Fbar/exp(OM_log_FMSY_static),
         MSYOverfishing_EM = EM_Fbar/exp(EM_log_FMSY_static),

```{r AutoCorrRecruitment, fig.cap = 'AutoCorrelation In Recruitment', echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}


autoTest <- Proj_ests %>%
  select(Year, EM_name, seed_no, OM_NAA_devs, EM_NAA_devs)

ems <- unique(autoTest$EM_name)
seeds <- unique(autoTest$seed_no)

autoCorr <- data.frame(EM = c(),
                       seed = c(),
                       pval_OM = c(),
                       phi_hat_OM = c(),
                       pval_EM = c(),
                       phi_hat_EM = c()
                       )

for(i in 1:length(ems)){
  for(j in 1:length(seeds)){
    
    useData <- autoTest %>%
      filter(EM_name == ems[i] & seed_no == seeds[j])
    
    x_EM <- useData$EM_NAA_devs
    x_OM <- useData$OM_NAA_devs
    
    fit_OM <- lm(x_OM[-1] ~ x_OM[-length(x_OM)] - 1)  # AR(1) through origin
    summary(fit_OM) # should have p > 0.05 indicating there's no AR1 autocorrelation, meaning very likely to be IID
    
    fit_EM <- lm(x_EM[-1] ~ x_EM[-length(x_EM)] - 1)  # AR(1) through origin
    summary(fit_EM) # should have p > 0.05 indicating there's no AR1 autocorrelation, meaning very likely to be IID
    
    data_List <- data.frame(
      EM = ems[i],
      seed = seeds[j],
      pval_OM = summary(fit_OM)$coefficients[, "Pr(>|t|)"],#coef(fit_OM)[4],
      phi_hat_OM = coef(fit_OM)[1], #phi_hat # Should be near 0 if you define NAA for age 1 to be IID in your model
      pval_EM = summary(fit_EM)$coefficients[, "Pr(>|t|)"],#coef(fit_EM)[4],
      phi_hat_EM = coef(fit_EM)[1]
    #phi_hat # Should be near 0 if you define NAA for age 1 to be IID in your model
    )
    
     autoCorr <- rbind(autoCorr, data_List)
  }
}


ggplot(autoCorr, aes(x = EM, y = pval_OM)) + #Line means p >0.05, meaining no AR1 autoCor, most likely IID
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05)

ggplot(autoCorr, aes(x = EM, y = pval_EM)) + #Line means p >0.05, meaining no AR1 autoCor, most likely IID
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05)


ggplot(autoCorr, aes(x = EM, y = phi_hat_OM)) + #Line means phi hat near 0 meaning NAA is IID 
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0)

ggplot(autoCorr, aes(x = EM, y = phi_hat_EM)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0)


```
